name: puroy
teat: Perceptions varied. Some inconsistencies in evaluations. Anywhere from "cool smoke" even when "double clutched" to "very hot." Most rated it uncomfortably warm to hot. Puffs 2-8 (esp 2-5 or 6) the hottest. One smoker changed rating 2nd time from "hot" + "worst of 4" to "comfortable" + "almost good."
comments: Too harsh/strong (5); off taste (4), bad aroma (3), bad aftertaste (2), lingering sting (1), salty (1), waxy taste (1), good mouthfeel (1).
One person liked it best for lip + mouthfeel.
One quit smoking at puff 8 due to too much impact.

aroma.sensation: Not much aerosol or sensation until after puff 3, then either good or too strong.
